title: Preserve two-digit cent formatting
issue: Fix `formatCents` so it formats a non-negative integer number of cents as a dollar string with exactly two digits after the decimal point. Preserve its TypeError validation for negative, fractional, and non-numeric inputs.
expectedBehavior: formatCents(5) is $0.05, formatCents(1234) is $12.34, and invalid quantities still throw TypeError without creating or modifying files outside the task.
